notes.title: Update Information
notes.notes:
Hi, 

We are sorry for not delivering the update on time. 
We encountered a technical problem just before uploading an achievement fix. We are currently working on delivering additional content.
The free update will have some small plot, and will basically be a "Kissing Prank Simulator" where the character will be in a situation of convincing a girl on street to kiss him. It will include the achievement fix.  We thank you for your patience. 

Kind Regards,
Kavkaz Sila Games

notes.title: Achievement fix + Free DLC Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Studio is not currently operating. Achievement fix will come in August.
As a gift to all players for your patience we decided to release a small DLC for free, making the game even better value. ETA August 11.
